definitions.gloss: natural cheese (cheese that is not processed cheese)
definitions.explanation: Cheese made directly from milk by curdling, draining, and ripening, without further melting and reblending. Distinguished in Japanese supermarket labeling from プロセスチーズ (processed cheese).

examples.japanese: ナチュラルチーズ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
ナチュラルチーズ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many kinds of natural cheese.

examples.japanese: ナチュラルチーズ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦プロセスチーズ→プロセスチーズ：29227_purosesuchiizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧⟦{風味|ふうみ}→風味：14622_fuumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧だ。
examples.english: Natural cheese has a richer flavor compared to processed cheese.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門店|せんもんてん}→専門店：15924_senmonten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{集|あつ}められた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧なナチュラルチーズ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: At specialty shops, various natural cheeses gathered from around the world are lined up on display.

notes:
ナチュラルチーズ is a loanword phrase based on English "natural cheese." In Japanese, it serves as a marketing/labeling term to distinguish authentic cheeses from ⟦プロセスチーズ→プロセスチーズ：29227_purosesuchiizu⟧ (processed cheese), which is melted and reblended from natural cheeses.

CATEGORY DETAILS:
- ナチュラルチーズ includes most well-known cheese varieties: チェダー, モッツァレラ, ⟦カマンベール→カマンベール：26373_kamanbeeru⟧, ブリー, パルメザン, ゴーダ, etc.
- The category is often subdivided by texture: ⟦{軟質|なんしつ}→軟質：29370_nanshitsu⟧ (soft), {半硬質|はんこうしつ} (semi-hard), ⟦{硬質|こうしつ}→硬質：16910_koushitsu⟧ (hard).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ナチュラルチーズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose a natural cheese
- ナチュラルチーズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|た}べ{比|くら}べる: to do a tasting comparison of natural cheeses
- ナチュラルチーズ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{盛|も}り{合|あ}わせ→盛り合わせ：21762_moriawase⟧: a cheese plate / assortment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦プロセスチーズ→プロセスチーズ：29227_purosesuchiizu⟧: processed cheese — melted and reblended natural cheeses, with longer shelf life and uniform flavor; the typical sliced cheese for sandwiches in Japan

USAGE:
- This is more of a labeling/category term than a word used in casual conversation. Most people simply say ⟦チーズ→チーズ：00026_chiizu⟧ in everyday speech and use ナチュラルチーズ when emphasizing the distinction (e.g., on packaging, in food magazines, or when shopping at a cheese counter).
- Japan's food labeling regulations formally distinguish ナチュラルチーズ and ⟦プロセスチーズ→プロセスチーズ：29227_purosesuchiizu⟧.
